name: What is included in a kitchen tile replacement estimate from City Dweller, LLC?

mainEntity.name: What is included in a kitchen tile replacement estimate from City Dweller, LLC?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our kitchen tile replacement estimates from City Dweller, LLC include a detailed breakdown of all project costs. This typically covers demolition and removal of existing tiles, subfloor preparation (such as leveling or repair), the cost of new tiles and setting materials (adhesive, grout, sealant), labor for installation, and cleanup. We also account for disposal fees and any necessary protection of adjacent areas. Our estimates are transparent and designed to give you a clear understanding of your investment, with no hidden fees. Any potential additional costs, like extensive subfloor repair, would be discussed upfront.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our estimates include demolition, subfloor preparation, new tile and material costs, labor for installation, and cleanup.
